decisions.reason: After Product A was withdrawn, this de-shuttering robot has a clearer modular role in tailored plant solutions, so unless its results now fall clearly below aspiration levels the firm is likely to keep it.

This storage robot serves a narrower niche and may face more risk of missing aspiration levels, but the firm's broad range, R&D orientation, and remaining organisational slack still favor keeping it for now.
As a distinct shuttering module within integrated automation projects, it likely compares adequately with aspiration levels and is therefore unlikely to be dropped within the coming year.

Because this 2024 product line fits closely with the firm's core process equipment and still has limited performance history, management would usually tolerate some early uncertainty rather than exit quickly.

The production analysis software is strategically close to the firm's move toward automated, future-ready plants, so even if early sales are somewhat below aspiration levels its complementarities with equipment and service make near-term withdrawal less likely.
